'''Ashnox Blackstar''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] living during the [[third Galactic War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SenatePlaza" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ashnox Blackstar appears in the [[2024]] Game Update 7.5 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', on the planet Coruscant at the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]]. Blackstar is not a vendor and not part of any missions and therefore can't be interacted with.<ref name="SenatePlaza" /> This character was a cameo of Ashnox Blackstar, leader of the costuming group Cosplayers of the Old Republic (COTOR).<ref name="cameo">{{WebCite|url=https://todayintor.com/2024/09/28/ashnox-blackstar-cameo-in-swtor/|text=Ashnox Blackstar Cameo in SWTOR|archivedate=20240930151353}}</ref>
